name: @geoblocks/ol-maplibre-layer
description: Geoblocks to render a MapLibre GL JS map as an OpenLayers layer.

scripts.start: npm run cp-workers && parcel serve examples/**/*.html
scripts.build: npm run cp-workers && parcel build --target demo
scripts.lint: npm run eslint && npm run typecheck
scripts.gh-pages: rm -rf dist && npm run doc && npm run build && gh-pages -d dist
scripts.cp-workers: mkdir -p examples/workers && cp node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs examples/workers/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs && cp node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-shared.mjs examples/workers/maplibre-gl-shared.mjs
